title: Client Servicing Manager
description:
**Client Servicing Manager – SEO**

**Company Description**

Pixel Studios Pvt. Ltd. is a digital design and marketing agency that blends creativity and technology to help businesses solve complex digital challenges. With over two decades of experience, we work with organisations across industries to strengthen their digital presence, improve brand communication, and achieve measurable business outcomes.

Our approach is built around understanding client requirements, developing practical digital strategies, and creating long-term partnerships through consistent service, learning, and innovation.

To know more about Pixel Studios and our work, visit www.pixel-studios.com.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Client Servicing Manager – SEO to manage and strengthen relationships with our SEO clients.

This is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai. The person will act as the primary point of contact between clients and our internal SEO team, ensuring that client requirements are clearly understood, SEO activities are executed as planned, performance is regularly communicated, and client expectations are effectively managed.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of SEO and digital marketing, along with strong client communication, account management, coordination, and presentation skills.

While this is not a hands-on SEO execution role, the candidate should be comfortable discussing SEO strategies, keyword performance, website traffic, rankings, technical SEO recommendations, content requirements, backlinks, and overall campaign performance with both clients and the internal SEO team.

**Key Responsibilities**

Manage day-to-day communication and relationships with assigned SEO clients.

Act as the primary bridge between clients and the internal SEO team.

Understand each client's business, industry, target audience, competitors, marketing objectives, and SEO goals.

Conduct client onboarding meetings and ensure requirements, expectations, deliverables, timelines, and KPIs are clearly documented.

Coordinate with SEO specialists, content teams, developers, designers, and other internal teams to ensure timely completion of SEO activities.

Understand and communicate SEO strategies including keyword targeting, on-page SEO, technical SEO, content optimisation, local SEO, link-building, and website optimisation.

Monitor campaign progress and ensure agreed SEO activities and deliverables are completed according to schedule.

Review SEO performance reports before presenting them to clients.

Conduct monthly and periodic client review meetings to discuss:

* Organic traffic performance
* Keyword ranking movements
* Search visibility
* Leads and conversions
* Website performance
* Content performance
* Technical SEO improvements
* Competitor performance

Upcoming SEO priorities and recommendations

Translate SEO data and technical information into clear, simple, business-focused insights for clients.

Set realistic expectations regarding SEO timelines, ranking improvements, traffic growth, and campaign outcomes.

Proactively identify campaign challenges and coordinate with the SEO team to develop appropriate solutions.

Follow up with clients for required approvals, website access, content inputs, development changes, and other campaign dependencies.

Maintain accurate documentation of client discussions, meeting notes, action items, approvals, and campaign requirements.

Ensure client queries, concerns, and escalation points are addressed promptly and professionally.

Monitor overall client satisfaction and work towards improving account retention.

Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts through additional SEO, website, performance marketing, content, social media, or other digital marketing services where relevant.

Participate in internal SEO review meetings and ensure client priorities and business objectives are clearly communicated to the delivery team.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
**About Rocketlane**

Rocketlane is a fast-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in customer onboarding and professional services automation.

Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to onboard customers and manage client projects—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.

We’re a close-knit team of over 200+ passionate professionals, all focused on building a product that teams love to use. Our journey has been fueled by $45M in funding from top investors, including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners.tners India, and super angels like Gokul Rajaram, Girish Mathrubootham, and Clark Valberg, etc.

**What will you do? (Role Overview)**

You’ll run discovery, solution design, configuration, integrations, and go-lives with a strong consultative voice. You’ll guide customers toward best practices, manage escalations when needed, and ensure they get value—fast. This is a high-ownership role designed for our future
**AI-first Professional Services org**
, where problem-solving, adaptability, and technical depth are essential.

**What You’ll Be Responsible For**

* Own the full onboarding lifecycle for enterprise customers—from kick-off to go-live.
* Lead requirement-gathering sessions and translate business workflows into Rocketlane configurations.
* Design and guide customers on best-practice implementations, even when that means pushing back or course-correcting.
* Work with customer teams (IT, HR, Finance, PMO, Ops) to design integrations with systems like HRMS, CRM, NetSuite, and fintech platforms.
* Collaborate with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Solutions) to unblock complex implementations.
* Manage risks, escalations, and tough conversations with clarity and calm.
* Adopt and shape AI-driven workflows to automate routine tasks and improve customer value delivery.
* Serve as the customer’s trusted advisor on onboarding processes, data flows, and integration patterns.

**Must-Have Skills**

**Technical & Integration Skills**

* **Hands-on experience with REST APIs, Webhooks**
  (reading API docs, testing endpoints, and understanding auth flows).
* Experience building or supporting
  **custom integrations**
  between SaaS platforms and third-party systems.
* Strong understanding of SaaS concepts: data models, webhooks, API limits, auth, and typical enterprise integration patterns.
* Comfortable working with tools like
  **Postman, Workato, Boomi, Zapier, Make, or other iPaaS solutions**
  .

**Implementation Expertise**

* 5+ years in a
  **customer-facing role at a SaaS company**
  (Implementations / Onboarding / Technical Consulting).
* Proven ability to
  **run enterprise onboarding projects**
  end-to-end with minimal supervision.
* Skilled in conducting discovery, documenting workflows, and translating requirements into system configurations.

**AI-First Aptitude**

* Strong curiosity and a builder mindset—someone who experiments, prototypes, and learns independently.
* Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development or scripting tools (e.g.,
  **Cursor, Replit, Lovable**
  or similar) to automate tasks, validate data, test APIs, or streamline workflows.
* Driven to “own your destiny” by building small scripts, utilities, or workflows that make onboarding faster, cleaner, and more scalable.

**Consultative & Communication Skills**

* Ability to
  **be assertive**
  —advise customers on the best approach rather than simply taking requirements.
* Experience navigating escalations and difficult conversations with professionalism.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to simplify technical concepts.

**Problem-Solving & Ownership**

* Strong analytical skills with a bias for action—thrives in ambiguity.
* High ownership mentality: independently unblocks, drives outcomes, and keeps projects moving.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience implementing or supporting systems like
  **Salesforce, Workday/BambooHR, NetSuite, ERP/CRM/Finance tools**
  .
* Background in Professional Services, Customer Success, or PSA tools (Rocketlane, Asana, Wrike, Jira, ClickUp, Salesforce PSA).
* Understanding of SSO/SAML, enterprise IT processes, or data migration.
* Familiarity with SQL for basic data validation.
* Project Management certifications (PMP, CSM) or equivalent mindset.
* Experience in high-growth SaaS environments.

**You should apply if you:**

* Love owning customer outcomes end-to-end.
* Are technically curious and enjoy solving integration and workflow problems.
* Thrive in customer conversations—even the tough ones.
* I want to help shape the future of an
  **AI-first Professional Services org**
  .
* Are energized by autonomy, impact, and building something that scales.

**Why join us?**

At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:

* **Impact and ownership**
  : You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best**
  : We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins**
  : Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From
  rap videos
  to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow**
  : We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* **Flexibility and balance**
  : While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pyjamas optional (at least outside the office).

title: Associate Manager - Operations
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Associate Manager - Operations to oversee end-to-end operational activities, manage a team, and coordinate with logistics service providers. The role requires strong stakeholder management skills, operational excellence, customer focus, and the ability to collaborate with Sales teams to support business growth and project requirements.

**Team Management**

* Monitor team productivity, establish KPIs, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide coaching and development opportunities.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, processes, and compliance requirements.

**Logistics & Service Provider Management**

* Manage relationships with Third-Party Logistics (3PL) providers, transportation vendors, and other service partners.
* Track and improve service levels, delivery performance, and operational efficiency.
* Conduct periodic reviews with service providers and drive corrective actions where required.
* Ensure timely resolution of operational challenges and service failures.

**Customer Escalation Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for operational escalations from customers.
* Investigate issues, coordinate with internal teams and service providers, and ensure timely closure.
* Drive root cause analysis and implement preventive measures to reduce recurring issues.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction through effective communication and problem resolution.

**Sales & Project Coordination**

* Partner with the Sales team to support customer projects, new business opportunities, and operational feasibility reviews.
* Coordinate project implementation activities and ensure successful execution.
* Provide operational inputs during customer discussions, solution design, and service delivery planning.

**Commercial & Contract Management**

* Negotiate and manage rate contracts with logistics service providers.
* Review, maintain, and administer transportation agreements, service contracts, and vendor documentation.
* Ensure contractual compliance and monitor service provider performance against agreed SLAs.
* Identify cost optimization opportunities and drive operational savings.

**Process & Compliance**

* Develop and implement operational processes to improve efficiency and service quality.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and customer commitments.
* Generate operational reports and provide regular performance updates to management.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong team leadership and people management skills.
* Experience managing 3PL providers, transportation vendors, and logistics operations.
* Excellent customer escalation and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Strong negotiation skills for rate contracts and vendor agreements.
* Good understanding of supply chain, warehousing, transportation, and distribution processes.
* Project coordination and execution skills.
* Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and ERP/WMS systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Commerce, or a related field.
* Experience in technology distribution, supply chain, logistics, or operations environment will be preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Customer satisfaction and escalation closure timelines.
* Service provider SLA adherence.
* Logistics cost optimization and savings.
* Team productivity and performance metrics.
* Project implementation success rate.
* On-time delivery and operational efficiency metrics.

This role is ideal for a hands-on operations professional who can effectively manage teams, service providers, customer expectations, and commercial aspects while supporting business growth initiatives.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Primary Job Responsibilities**
**Customer Adoption & Engagement**

* Establish strong customer relationships and accelerate the active use of contracted HPE solutions so customers realize measurable business and technical outcomes.
* Lead onboarding, stakeholder mapping, success planning, and regular virtual engagement across the customer lifecycle.
* Define adoption objectives, milestones, and success measures aligned with customer priorities.
* Conduct adoption reviews, business reviews, workshops, and executive engagements to demonstrate progress and value.
* Identify adoption barriers, customer-health risks, and capability gaps; coordinate action plans with Support, Services, Sales, Product, and Partners.

**Consumption & Upsell Growth**

* Increase utilization of contracted capacity and translate sustained demand growth into qualified upsell opportunities for additional capacity, users, services, or higher billing tiers.
* Monitor telemetry, utilization, burn rate, workload growth, billing tiers, and capacity thresholds to identify consumption trends.
* Build consumption acceleration plans for underutilized environments and track progress against agreed targets.
* Forecast when current capacity or entitlement will be exhausted and identify the trigger point for expansion.
* Partner with Sales and solution teams to convert qualified capacity-growth signals into pipeline and support the customer value case.

**Cross-Sell**

* Expand the customer relationship into adjacent HPE solutions, workloads, or services that address unmet business needs beyond the current deployment.
* Use success plans, business reviews, telemetry, account insights, and customer priorities to identify adjacent solution opportunities.
* Facilitate workload-discovery sessions and map customer use cases to relevant HPE capabilities.
* Qualify and document opportunities with clear use cases, customer outcomes, dependencies, and next actions.
* Coordinate with Account Sales, GreenLake Specialists, Solution Architects and Partners to develop the solution, initiate proof-of-value activity, and progress qualified leads.

**Tech Refresh**

* Modernize aging, constrained, or end-of-support infrastructure to reduce operational risk, improve performance, and create a planned refresh or migration opportunity.
* Review asset age, lifecycle status, support coverage, performance, capacity, resiliency, and technology dependencies.
* Identify refresh candidates, customer risks, modernization priorities, and the business impact of delaying action.
* Develop a phased refresh roadmap aligned with budget cycles, workload priorities, architecture standards, and sustainability goals.
* Position appropriate HPE modernization options and validate migration, data-protection, operational-readiness, and implementation requirements.
* Partner with Sales, Specialists, Services, and Partners to qualify the refresh opportunity and maintain clear milestones through proposal and execution.

**Renewal**

* Protect recurring revenue by proving realized value, resolving risks early, and preparing the customer and account team for a timely renewal decision.
* Maintain renewal readiness throughout the lifecycle by tracking value realization, customer health, adoption, consumption, satisfaction, and open risks.
* Begin structured renewal planning well in advance of the contract end date, confirming stakeholders, decision criteria, procurement steps, and timeline.
* Create a value and outcome summary that connects achieved results and future priorities to the renewal recommendation.
* Partner with Sales and renewal teams to confirm scope, forecast status, expansion potential, approvals, and customer actions through closure.

**Technical & Solution Guidance**

* Apply technical expertise to guide customers on workload adoption and production readiness through remote engagement channels.
* Collaborate with Advisory Services, Professional Services, Partners, and account teams to accelerate customer outcomes.
* Support customers in evaluating architecture considerations, workload migration strategies, resiliency requirements, and operational readiness.
* Advocate for innovation and early adoption of cloud and hybrid cloud solutions.

**Cross-Functional & Partner Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Partner Ecosystems to ensure customer success.
* Coordinate with Global System Integrators (GSIs), System Integrators (SIs), Cloud Service Providers (CSPs), and other ecosystem partners to accelerate customer adoption and project execution.
* Escalate and coordinate resolution of customer blockers, risks, and adoption challenges.

**Voice of Customer & Continuous Improvement**

* Capture customer feedback and product adoption insights throughout the customer lifecycle.
* Advocate customer needs and use cases with Product Management and Engineering teams.
* Help identify capability gaps and improvement opportunities through a structured feedback process.
* Share knowledge, mentor peers, and contribute to internal initiatives as a subject matter expert.

**Experience**
**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Typically, 2–4 years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, customer support, service delivery, presales, professional services, or another customer-facing technology role.
* Practical experience supporting customers across onboarding, adoption, usage reviews, issue coordination, or value-realization activities.
* Exposure to cloud, hybrid cloud, infrastructure, SaaS, or as-a-Service environments, with the ability to learn the assigned solution portfolio.
* Experience using customer data, CRM or customer-success tools, dashboards, and standard reporting to track activities, risks, health, and follow-up actions.
* Comfort managing a defined portfolio of customers or workstreams with guidance, escalating complex commercial or technical matters when required.
* Experience working through remote and virtual engagement models is preferred.

**Technical & Business Knowledge**

* Working knowledge of cloud, hybrid cloud, enterprise infrastructure, SaaS, and as-a-Service concepts, including compute, storage, networking, virtualization, backup, and data protection.
* Basic familiarity with one or more public cloud platforms, such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud, and how they connect with enterprise data-centre environments.
* Ability to understand common customer workloads and use cases—including virtualization and containers, SAP, AI and analytics, VDI, backup and data protection, and high-performance computing—without requiring deep architectural expertise.
* Understands foundational concepts related to workload migration, availability, resiliency, security, capacity, consumption, support lifecycle, and operational readiness.
* Understands core customer-success and commercial concepts, including onboarding, adoption, value realization, business reviews, customer health, retention, renewal, and expansion.
* Can connect customer goals and operational challenges to relevant solution benefits and explain technical information in clear business language.
* Ability to develop and maintain basic success plans, adoption actions, risk logs, and customer outcome summaries using established templates and playbooks.
* Recognizes when specialist, sales, services, support, or partner expertise is required and coordinates the appropriate follow-up.

**Customer Success Capabilities**

* Experience utilizing customer telemetry, health scores, adoption analytics, and usage insights to drive customer outcomes.
* Ability to manage a portfolio of customers efficiently through scalable digital engagement strategies.
* Strong virtual communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to deliver customer success at scale through digital programs, automated campaigns, webinars, and virtual workshops.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the customer organization, including executives, business leaders, architects, developers, and IT administrators.
* Proven ability to translate technical concepts into business value and actionable customer success plans.
* Strong collaboration skills with a "One Team" mindset and passion for customer success.
* Ability to manage complex customer situations, cross-functional projects, and escalations.
* Demonstrated business acumen with the ability to align technology adoption to business outcomes.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline preferred.

·      Monitor project progress and resolve execution-related issues to minimise delays.

·      Coordinate with relevant DISCOMs and other stakeholders for required approvals, net metering, inspections, and subsidy-related processes, as applicable.

·      Develop local talent and ensure effective coordination between sales, channel partners, and project execution teams.

·      Establish regular reporting, performance monitoring, and operational review mechanisms.

·      Monitor sales, order bookings, installations, project turnaround time, customer satisfaction, and profitability.

* Ensure CRM compliance, data accuracy, and timely pipeline updates.

description:

This hybrid role for a senior consultant in customer service focuses on designing and optimizing advanced service strategies and processes for global clients. The consultant will use deep domain expertise to improve customer experience outcomes streamline operations and implement scalable solutions that align with enterprise objectives. The role requires 12 to 15 years of experience and offers day shifts without travel.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive strategic customer service transformation initiatives by assessing current service models identifying critical gaps and proposing pragmatic improvements that increase satisfaction and operational efficiency.
* Lead the design of end to end customer service workflows that are adaptable for hybrid work arrangements while ensuring consistent quality and adherence to enterprise standards.
* Oversee implementation of customer service process enhancements by coordinating with stakeholders across operations technology and quality teams to ensure timely and effective adoption.
* Provide expert guidance on contact center practices including case management escalation handling and omnichannel interactions to optimize first contact resolution and customer loyalty.
* Develop detailed service performance metrics dashboards and reporting frameworks that enable leadership to make data informed decisions on resource allocation and process refinement.
* Collaborate with client teams to define clear service level objectives and translate them into actionable playbooks for day shift operations across hybrid and onsite environments.
* Mentor and coach service managers and senior analysts to elevate skills in problem solving communication and continuous improvement within the customer service function.
* Coordinate root cause analysis for recurring customer pain points and define corrective actions that reduce handling time error rates and repeat contacts for key customer segments.
* Guide the adoption of digital tools such as knowledge bases workflow automation and case tracking solutions to standardize responses and improve consistency across hybrid teams.
* Conduct regular operational reviews to validate compliance with enterprise policies regulatory requirements and risk controls relevant to customer service activities.
* Optimize workforce management strategies for hybrid day shift teams by recommending staffing patterns performance targets and training needs that support sustainable outcomes.
* Partner with product and technology groups to ensure customer feedback from service interactions is translated into actionable enhancements to offerings and experiences.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement by defining measurable initiatives that enhance customer trust strengthen brand reputation and deliver tangible value to society through better service accessibility.

* Demonstrate extensive experience of 12 to 15 years in complex customer service environments with proven capability to design and refine large scale service operations for diverse clients.
* Possess advanced proficiency in customer service methodologies including contact center operations case lifecycle management and quality monitoring with a focus on outcome based metrics.
* Apply strong analytical and problem solving skills to interpret service performance data identify trends and recommend targeted interventions that directly improve customer outcomes.
* Utilize excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to align business goals with practical service delivery strategies across hybrid and onsite teams.
* Bring hands on experience in implementing process standardization and documentation for customer service workflows ensuring clarity consistency and ease of adoption for teams.
* Exhibit solid knowledge of customer relationship practices including feedback management surveys and issue resolution frameworks that support high levels of customer trust.
* Show familiarity with digital enablement tools for customer service such as ticketing systems knowledge repositories and workflow solutions that facilitate efficient day shift operations.
* Display capability in mentoring and developing service professionals by providing structured guidance and feedback that strengthens team performance and engagement.
* Maintain strong understanding of compliance and data protection considerations in customer interactions ensuring that all service processes safeguard customer information.
* Demonstrate adaptability to hybrid work models by defining collaboration norms productivity measures and communication practices suitable for distributed service teams.
* Present a track record of delivering measurable improvements in customer service including reduced complaints higher satisfaction scores and enhanced operational resilience.
* Bring consulting experience with multinational organizations enabling effective navigation of complex stakeholder landscapes and alignment with global service standards.

description:
**Description**
About Amazon.com
  
  
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
  
  
**About The Role**
Account Management- Vendor Consultant
  
  
As a Vendor Consultant and part of Selling Partner Engagement and Growth (SPEG), you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon Vendors.
  
  
SPEG team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative candidate to join our team. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. You will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon.com.
  
  
You will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, Catalog management, inventory management, finance, operations, and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on the strategic and operational aspects of managing the customer relationships with our vendors.
  
  
You will conceive, create, and analyze a wide range of marketing and site merchandising efforts, to include marketing campaigns to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. Also you will look into strategic and operational aspects of their business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting the vendor’s business. In addition, you are expected to proactively identify areas for growing Vendor’s business by developing strategies.

* Success will be measured by the performance of your internal teams on input metrics and impact of vendors on creating a great customer experience for buying consumers
* Partnering with the Retail Category Team and managing the vendor relationship by championing the vendor’s needs at Amazon
* Build communication channels at all levels, set proper expectations, provide clear status communications, and manage towards a growth plan for the vendors
* Build and execute on a strategic account plan that delivers on key business opportunities and relevant KPIs for the vendors and Amazon
* Work with internal Amazon teams/vendors to improve operational aspects of their business in providing a great consumer experience
* Conduct deep dive analysis on the handled issues for the vendors and publish recommendations and action plans based on data to improve vendor experience
* Provide thought leadership around planning, roadmaps and execution
* Establish long term partnerships with key vendor partners for the group of vendors handled
* Support the launches of new programs, categories and features
* Conduct regular WBR, MBRs with the vendors highlight business metric performance and building action plans

* Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
* Can manage multiple projects and meet deadlines

title: Books Head/Account Manager – Publishing Services
description:
Company – Thomson Digital

Experience – 5-7 Years

Location - Chennai

**Role Overview**

The role requires a strong understanding of end-to-end book production, excellent client communication skills, and the ability to coordinate effectively with internal production, editorial, composition, quality, and technology teams.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with a publishing house or a publishing services company, understand the complete book production lifecycle, and be capable of managing customer expectations, delivery schedules, quality standards, and operational performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1.     End-to-End Book Production Management**

* Demonstrate a thorough understanding of the complete book production lifecycle, from manuscript receipt to final deliverables.
* Manage and monitor production stages, including:
* Manuscript assessment, pre-editing, and content preparation.
* Copyediting, language editing, and proofreading.
* Typesetting and composition, including print and digital formats.
* Artwork, tables, figures, permissions, and reference management.
* Author queries, corrections, and review cycles.
* Page proofing, quality checks, and final file validation.
* Indexing, where applicable, and preparation of print-ready PDFs and eBook outputs.
* Final delivery, archival, and project closure.
* Ensure adherence to client-specific workflows, production schedules, quality benchmarks, and service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Monitor project progress, identify bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions to avoid delays and rework.

**2.     Production Coordination & Delivery**

* Coordinate with production managers, editors, typesetters, proofreaders, quality teams, and other stakeholders.
* Track multiple titles and projects simultaneously, ensuring visibility into milestones, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
* Monitor production volumes, turnaround times (TAT), quality metrics, and pending activities.
* Ensure that project teams have clear briefs, specifications, and priorities.
* Escalate risks in advance and drive timely resolution of production issues.
* Ensure compliance with publishing standards, customer specifications, and internal quality processes.

**3. Quality & Process Improvement**

* Maintain high standards of editorial, compositional, and final-delivery quality.
* Analyse recurring errors, customer feedback, rework, and production delays to identify root causes.
* Work with internal teams to implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve productivity, and reduce production costs without compromising quality.
* Support the adoption of workflow automation, digital publishing solutions, and AI-enabled tools wherever relevant.

title: Adoption Manager Content & Channel
description:
**Summary**
The Adoption Manager is responsible for driving hands-on adoption of Guided Buying across priority Layer-4 taxonomy sub-categories and rollout markets. The role converts category strategy into practical buying journeys, activates super-user networks, coordinates targeted enablement, and uses adoption data to improve user behavior and channel conversion. Success in this role means users are guided to the right buying channels because the experience is clear, relevant, and easier than off-channel alternatives.
  
 
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Adoption planning:**
  Develop sub-category adoption plans with category managers, defining the target buying channel, user groups, buying scenarios, adoption risks, and intervention plan for each wave.
* **Buying journey design:**
  Map how users buy today and define the future-state buying journey across catalogues, contract-linked purchase orders, preferred suppliers, tactical sourcing, or other approved routes.
* **Super-user activation:**
  Identify, engage, and manage super users by market, location, or user group; establish feedback loops and ensure user issues are captured, prioritised, and resolved.
* **Enablement and communications:**
  Partner with Change & Enablement and Experience teams to deliver targeted walkthroughs, Q&A, quick reference material, and nudges that address specific buying behaviours.
* **Data-led intervention:**
  Monitor adoption signals including Guided Buying usage, channel utilisation, free-text buying, off-channel activity, catalogue usage, contract operationalisation, and recurring user issues.
* **Issue resolution:**
  Work with C&C Operations, Local Procurement, category owners, supplier enablement, and BAU teams to resolve root causes such as content gaps, channel design issues, supplier readiness, data quality, or unclear ownership.
* **Governance and reporting:**
  Maintain the adoption tracker, manage actions and risks, provide progress updates to the Adoption Lead, and escalate decisions or blockers that put adoption targets at risk.

 
  
**Required Skills:**

* **P2P/S2P and procurement-channel adoption:**
  Approximately seven or more years in procurement or transformation, including direct work with guided buying, catalogues, contract-linked buying, or preferred-supplier routes to drive measurable change in adoption.
* **Hands-on adoption delivery:**
  Owned adoption plans, user segmentation, buying journeys, interventions, super-user networks, and issue resolution—not only communications or training.
* **Data-led problem solving:**
  Used channel-utilisation, free-text, off-channel, catalogue, contract, or user-issue data to diagnose causes and prioritise action to drive adoption metrics.
* **Influence across functions and markets:**
  Secured delivery from category, procurement operations, suppliers, technology, change, and local-market teams without direct authority.
* **Transformation delivery and ambiguity:**
  Delivered in a complex rollout, managed dependencies and risks, and converted unclear requirements into an actionable plan with governance.

 
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* **SAP Ariba ecosystem exposure:**
  Practical exposure to SAP Ariba Guided Buying, SLP, Supplier Business Network, or a comparable procurement platform.
* **BAU transition and repeatability:**
  Built a playbook, governance cadence, exit criteria, and named ownership to sustain adoption after rollout.

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
  
  
Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
  
  
Location
  
  
India
  
  
**About The Role**
The
**Partner Success Manager**
is accountable for helping Kinaxis value added reseller (VAR) partners build productive, scalable, and predictable businesses around Kinaxis solutions. The role connects partner enablement, operating discipline, pipeline governance, and alliance management so that partners are equipped to create demand, progress opportunities, close business, and deliver a consistent customer experience.
  
  
This is a hands-on orchestration role. The Partner Success Manager works across VAR leadership, partner sellers and solution consultants, Kinaxis sales, pre-sales, marketing, services, customer success, operations, and legal teams. The successful candidate combines strong partner relationships with rigorous execution and uses data to identify risks, remove barriers, and improve partner performance.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Develop and manage role-based partner enablement, onboarding, certification, product training, and ongoing knowledge programs.
* Assess partner capabilities, identify readiness gaps, and drive remediation plans with clear milestones and ownership.
* Ensure partners can effectively position Kinaxis solutions, qualify opportunities, and leverage Kinaxis resources.
* Drive adoption of approved tools, processes, programs, and new product/solution launches.
* Establish and improve partner delivery readiness and standards to ensure consistent implementation quality and customer outcomes.
* Manage partner operations, governance, business reviews, pipeline cadence, scorecards, records, approvals, and action tracking.
* Partner with VAR sales leaders to build account plans, campaigns, qualified pipeline, and revenue opportunities.
* Lead pipeline reviews, monitor opportunity progression and CRM hygiene, and coordinate internal resources to advance priority deals.
* Analyze pipeline and sales performance metrics to identify risks and drive corrective actions.
* Build strong executive and functional relationships and develop joint business plans with partners.
* Align Kinaxis and partner stakeholders on priorities, responsibilities, investments, and execution.
* Identify opportunities to expand partner capabilities, market coverage, industry reach, and geographic presence.
* Represent partner needs internally while balancing customer outcomes and Kinaxis business priorities.

**Education Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

What we are looking for
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in partner management, channel sales or partner operations.
* Experience working with VARs, system integrators, software partners, or indirect go-to-market models.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software sales cycles, pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and partner economics.
* Ability to translate strategy into actionable plans, measurable milestones, and effective execution across stakeholders.
* Strong relationship management, communication, presentation, facilitation, and executive engagement skills.
* Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in CRM, reporting, collaboration, and productivity tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions and functions with sound judgment and attention to detail.
* Preferred: Experience in supply chain planning, SaaS, enterprise applications, or digital transformation.
* Preferred: Experience managing global/multi-regional partner portfolios, partner enablement, certifications, demand generation, channel programs, or complex co-sell models.

**#Intermediate, #Senior**

Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
  
  
**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:**
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. title: Business Relationship Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title: Business Relationship Manager**
**Overview**
The Business Relationship Manager serves as the primary link between the AI team and business units across the organization. The role is responsible for gathering business requirements, prioritizing AI initiatives, supporting technology rollouts, and ensuring successful adoption and business value of AI solutions.
  
  
The role will work closely with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and Learning & Development to drive adoption, track usage and satisfaction, and address adoption risks.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibility**

* Own and maintain relationships with business unit stakeholders across the organization, serving as their primary point of contact for AI team engagement.
* Gather business requirements and user needs, translating them into prioritized, well-scoped inputs for the engineering team.
* Define, track, and report on adoption and usage metrics for deployed AI solutions — not just delivery status.
* Design and execute change communication and rollout plans for phased deployments, partnering with Learning & Development on training hand-off.
* Serve as the escalation point for business-unit feedback and concerns regarding AI tooling and automations.
* Identify early signals of adoption risk and drive corrective action before they surface as broader dissatisfaction.
* Facilitate prioritization discussions, bringing business context and stakeholder impact to bear on engineering roadmap decisions.
* Report adoption outcomes, business value, and stakeholder sentiment to executive leadership.
* Build and maintain a repeatable framework for onboarding new business units onto AI-enabled workflows.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Communications, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years of experience in business relationship management, stakeholder management, product management, customer success, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience driving adoption of new technology or business processes.
* Experience defining and tracking adoption, usage, or satisfaction metrics.
* Experience gathering business requirements and working with technical/engineering teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple business units.
* Working knowledge of AI and automation capabilities and limitations.
* Willingness to work in a 24/7 environment

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Experience in financial services, healthcare, or another regulated industry.
* Experience supporting AI, automation, or emerging technology rollouts.
* Experience managing relationships across multiple departments.
* Change management certification such as Prosci ADKAR or CCMP.
* Business analysis certification such as CBAP or PMI-PBA.
* Product/program management certification such as PMP or CSPO.

title: Delivery Lead
description:
Manager - ST&S Delivery

JOB DESCRIPTION

Manager/Associate Director - ST&S Delivery

Settlements | iData | Contracts & Confirmations | Accounting, Reporting & Controls

Role Purpose

The Manager, ST&S Delivery will own end-to-end service delivery across assigned Oil & Gas Supply, Trading & Shipping operations covering Settlements, iData, Contracts & Confirmations, and Accounting, Reporting & Control, the role will lead operational teams, manage client governance, maintain service performance and controls, resolve material escalations, and execute the agreed transformation roadmap. The Manager will translate the Delivery Head’s strategic direction into operational plans and ensure accurate, timely and controlled delivery across high-value and time-sensitive processes.

Key Responsibilities

•

Own delivery performance across assigned ST&S processes, ensuring achievement of agreed SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, close-calendar commitments and control requirements.

•

Lead operational delivery across settlements, reference and master data, contracts and confirmations, and accounting, reporting and controls.

•

Establish effective workload management, capacity planning, staffing, prioritization and resource-deployment practices across delivery teams.

•

Monitor volumes, work queues, ageing, exceptions, reconciliations, productivity, quality and operational risks; intervene early where performance is at risk.

•

Lead resolution of material settlement breaks, confirmation mismatches, contract exceptions, data defects, reconciliation differences, accounting issues and control failures.

•

Act as the primary operational contact for assigned client stakeholders and lead service reviews covering delivery, risks, controls, improvement actions and transformation progress.

•

Build effective relationships across trading operations, finance, treasury, legal, tax, credit, risk, compliance, technology and data teams.

•

Ensure adherence to maker-checker controls, four-eye reviews, delegated authorities, segregation of duties, approval protocols, records retention and audit-trail requirements.

•

Oversee operational-risk events, control incidents, audit findings, business-continuity requirements and remediation actions.

•

Prepare and present governance packs covering service levels, quality, ageing, productivity, risk, controls, financial performance and improvement outcomes.

•

Convert the transformation roadmap into executable initiatives, milestones, resource plans, readiness criteria and measurable benefits.

•

Lead process diagnostics and standardization; sponsor workflow, digitization, analytics and automation opportunities after stabilizing performance and addressing source-data causes.

•

Ensure SME participation across design, validation, testing, UAT, knowledge transfer, hypercare and post-implementation reviews.

•

Retain appropriate human review and approval for material commercial, legal, regulatory, accounting and payment decisions.

•

Lead Deputy Managers, Team Leads and operational teams; set objectives, coach leaders, build cross-skilling, maintain succession coverage and strengthen accountability.

Manager - ST&S Delivery

Core Domain & Functional Skills

•

Strong understanding of the Oil & Gas, energy or commodity-trading lifecycle across crude, products, gas, LNG and/or power.

•

Settlements: AR/AP invoicing, pricing validation, payment preparation, netting, cash allocation, collections, disputes, intercompany, ancillary/brokerage settlements and reconciliations.

•

iData: counterparty and bank-account records, payment data, standard settlement instructions, settlement and netting reference data, governance and data-quality remediation.

•

Contracts & Confirmations: contract administration, trade-term validation, physical and derivative confirmations, electronic matching, discrepancy management and counterparty engagement.

•

Accounting, Reporting & Controls: journals, derivative and balance-sheet accounting, P&L and working-capital reconciliations, financial close, controls, audit and reporting support.

•

Ability to manage service performance, capacity, productivity, operational risk, governance and benefits realization in a multi-stakeholder environment.

•

Working exposure to ETRM/CTRM platforms, ERP or finance systems, reconciliation tools, workflow/case-management platforms, automation and reporting dashboards.

Experience & Qualifications

•

11-14 years of relevant experience in Oil & Gas, energy or commodity-trading operations, including at least 7 years in service delivery, operations management or people leadership.

•

Demonstrated experience managing multi-process or multi-team operations in an SLA-driven and control-oriented environment.

•

Strong experience in at least two scope areas, with end-to-end awareness across the wider ST&S lifecycle.

•

Proven ability to manage client stakeholders, service reviews, operational escalations and cross-functional dependencies.

•

Experience in transition, process standardization, workflow implementation, automation, digitization or operating-model transformation.

•

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Commerce, Engineering, Technology, Energy Management or a related discipline. Relevant accounting, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, transformation or change certification is desirable.

•

Fluent business English, with flexibility to support business and market timelines.

Leadership & Behavioural Expectations

•

Strong ownership and accountability for delivery outcomes, controls and stakeholder commitments.

•

Ability to balance service, risk, commercial, people and transformation priorities.

•

Sound judgement, structured problem solving and confidence in managing senior stakeholders and difficult escalations.

•

Clear written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to work across cultures, commodities, regions and systems.

•

A coaching mindset that develops people, protects critical knowledge and promotes continuous improvement.

Measures of Success SLA and KPI achievement | accurate and timely delivery | fewer aged exceptions and recurring breaks | stronger controls | effective client governance | improved productivity and visibility | sustained transformation benefits | capable and engaged teams

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services**
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) -**
**SAP FICO/SD - DRC E-Invoicing E-Reporting**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions through SAP-enabled transformation. This role sits within Tax Transformation Consulting and focuses on SAP FICO/SD integration and SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) capabilities supporting e-invoicing, e-reporting, and digital compliance requirements. You will work across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to help design and deliver scalable compliance solutions in complex ERP environments.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology-enabled, cutting-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 8 to 15+ years of total experience.
* 5+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.
* Experience with design and implement SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) solutions that support global e-invoicing, statutory reporting, and digital compliance requirements. Experience of working across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable SAP-based compliance capabilities across complex ERP environments. Ability to translate country-specific statutory and e-invoicing requirements into functional specifications, solution designs, and testing scenarios.
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules - SD-FI & MM-FI
* Strong in project management, leadership abilities, and has tendency to independently execute project cycles and deliverables.
* Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time.
* Effective communications and strong presentation and team building skills. Initiative-taking participates in firm-based activities and owns his/her career.
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation

Preferred:
  
  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S4 HANA) Certified
* Experience with tax technology applications i.e., ONESOURCE /Global NEXT Integration, Vertex/Accelerator & Chain flow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, Sovos
* Central Finance with Tax integration, Transfer Pricing, BRIM
* Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, Asset Accounting implementation.

description:

As we expand our Extended Detection and Response (XDR) capabilities, we are building a next-generation data platform designed for massive scale, real-time intelligence, and high-performance security analytics.

**Role Overview**

The Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM) is responsible for building strong, long-term relationships with customers, ensuring they achieve maximum value from our solutions, and driving retention and growth. This role combines customer advocacy, product expertise, and business acumen to help clients succeed while supporting the company’s strategic objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Relationship Management**

• Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.

• Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers.

• Guide customers through onboarding and implementation.

• Drive product adoption by educating customers on features, best practices, and use cases.

• Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts.

• Pitch relevant case studies to demonstrate value and encourage expansion.

• Negotiate and secure multi-year contracts with existing customers to strengthen long-term partnerships.

• Proactively manage churn risk and develop retention strategies.

**Customer Advocacy**

• Act as the voice of the customer internally, providing feedback to product and support teams.

• Ensure customer satisfaction by resolving issues promptly and effectively

• Monitor account health metrics (usage, engagement, renewals).

• Account Planning: Develop annual success plans for high-value accounts that outline specific growth and expansion targets.

**Qualifications & Skills**

• Experience: 2–5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales (preferably in SaaS or technology).

• Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to present to senior stakeholders.

• Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset with the ability to understand customer challenges and propose solutions.

• Product Knowledge: Ability to quickly learn and articulate product capabilities.

• Negotiation: Skilled in pitching case studies and securing multi-year contracts.

• Collaboration: Team player with cross-functional coordination skills (Sales, Product, Support).

• Flexibility: Willingness to work across time zones and adapt to customer needs

**Performance Metrics**

• Customer retention rate.

• Net revenue retention (NRR) Customer satisfaction (CSAT/NPS).

• Product adoption and usage growth.

• Upsell/cross-sell revenue contribution.

• Number/value of multi-year contracts secured.

• Secure Case Studies from Happy Customers.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

• Customer-centric mindset with a passion for helping clients succeed.

• Strong presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Ability to balance multiple accounts and prioritize effectively.

• Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn

* Familiarity with US healthcare providers, hospitals, payors, or healthcare workflows is an added advantage.

* Experience working with enterprise customers and managing complex implementations or multiple stakeholders is a plus.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an accomplished Senior Delivery Manager with 15+ years of experience to lead complex Insurance technology engagements for global clients. The role requires broad functional and technical understanding of Guidewire InsuranceSuite, surrounding digital and integration platforms, and a strong command of service management and ITIL principles. The successful candidate will own client outcomes, delivery performance, financial health, service quality, people leadership and continuous improvement across a large engagement or a portfolio of engagements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, complex or multiple Insurance engagements across implementation, transformation, application maintenance and support, enhancements, integration, testing, release and production operations.
* Provide executive governance across scope, schedule, quality, SLAs, risks, dependencies and benefits, with clear accountability for committed client outcomes.
* Lead geographically distributed, multidisciplinary teams across onshore, nearshore and offshore locations, including service managers, architects, functional consultants, engineering, testing, DevOps and service management teams.
* Build trusted relationships with client executives, business leaders, technology stakeholders, product owners and third-party partners, and act as the senior escalation point for delivery and service matters.
* Establish and run governance forums, steering committees, service reviews and executive reporting with fact-based insights, decisions and actions.
* Drive predictable delivery through integrated planning, demand and capacity management, dependency management, release readiness, quality gates and disciplined change control.
* Own performance against contractual service levels and experience measures; lead recovery plans where performance is at risk and ensure transparent reporting of trends and corrective actions.
* Oversee major incident response, problem management, root-cause analysis, change and release management, service transition, knowledge management and operational resilience.
* Ensure adherence to ITIL-aligned processes, client controls, security requirements, regulatory obligations, audit expectations and delivery standards.
* Drive continuous improvement, automation, shift-left, observability, engineering excellence and AI-enabled operations to improve reliability, responsiveness and cost efficiency.
* Support solutioning, estimation, proposal development, transition planning and mobilization for new opportunities and scope expansion.
* Develop leadership capability and succession across the account; coach managers and senior team members, manage performance, improve retention and build a strong delivery culture.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Guidewire and platform leadership**

* Broad knowledge across Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ClaimCenter, including configuration, integration, data, digital channels, rating, batch processing, rules, workflows and reporting.
* Understanding of Guidewire Cloud delivery and operations, cloud migration considerations, platform upgrades, environment strategy, deployment pipelines and production support models.
* Ability to oversee Guidewire integrations with policy, claims, billing, document, payment, finance, customer relationship management, data, analytics, identity and other enterprise platforms.
* Knowledge of modern architecture and engineering practices involving APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, middleware, cloud services, secure DevOps, automated delivery pipelines, test automation and observability.
* Working knowledge of adjacent Insurance platforms and technologies such as digital portals, data and analytics platforms, document and content management, rating solutions, enterprise integration and cloud infrastructure.

**Service management and operational excellence**

* Practical application of ITIL principles across incident, major incident, problem, change, release, request, configuration, knowledge, availability, capacity and service-level management.
* Experience establishing operating models, service governance, escalation paths, responsibility structures, support coverage, on-call models and service improvement plans.
* Ability to use operational data to identify recurring failure patterns, service risks, demand drivers and improvement opportunities, and convert insights into measurable actions.

**Leadership and delivery attributes**

* Strong Insurance domain understanding, preferably Property and Casualty, across policy administration, underwriting, billing, claims and related business processes.
* Proven success delivering large-scale or multi-account technology engagements for global clients, with accountability for distributed teams and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to operate confidently across executive governance, commercial management, delivery detail and technical risk while maintaining focus on business outcomes.
* Strong leadership presence, communication, negotiation, conflict resolution and stakeholder management skills.
* Commercial acumen covering estimation, staffing, budgeting, forecasting, productivity, contract interpretation and change control.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, scaled delivery and traditional delivery methods, with the judgment to apply fit-for-purpose governance.
* Working familiarity with service and engineering tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps, monitoring platforms, knowledge repositories and automated delivery toolchains.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 15+ years of overall experience in technology delivery, including substantial leadership experience in Insurance engagements.
* Proven experience as a Senior Delivery Manager, Program Manager, Account Delivery Lead or equivalent, managing a large engagement or multiple concurrent teams across global clients.
* Demonstrable delivery knowledge across Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ClaimCenter, plus associated digital, integration, data and cloud platforms.
* Experience leading implementation and/or managed services engagements with responsibility for service performance, client governance, financials, people and risk.
* Strong understanding of ITIL and service management principles, including practical experience across incident, problem, change, release and service-level management.
* A bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Guidewire certification in one or more InsuranceSuite modules; broader cross-module or cloud credentials are advantageous.
* ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
* Program or project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or an Agile certification.
* Experience with Guidewire Cloud, cloud transformation, complex platform modernization or large-scale service transition.
* Exposure to solution shaping, presales, contract negotiations, account growth and capability development.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Financial Services

title: Regional Key Account Manager
description:
**The Opportunity**

At Plum, our offline business continues to grow, and Modern Trade plays an important role in bringing our products closer to consumers across India.

We're looking for a Regional Key Account Manager – Modern Trade who can help us build a stronger, more visible and higher-performing Plum presence across Tamil Nadu and Kerala.

This is not just about managing retail accounts. It's about building businesses within those accounts—strengthening customer partnerships, improving in-store execution, driving Beauty Advisor (BA) productivity and finding new opportunities to grow.

You'll work with some of the region's leading retail partners, including Health & Glow, Lulu, Reliance, More Retail, Apollo, DMart, Star Bazaar, Purplle, NewU and other regional chains.

We're looking for someone who enjoys being close to the market, understands what drives consumers to pick a product off the shelf, and knows how to turn strong retail relationships into measurable business growth.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Build & Grow Key Accounts**

* Own revenue, growth and commercial performance across assigned Modern Trade accounts.
* Build strong relationships with key retail partners and identify opportunities to expand Plum's business.
* Drive primary and secondary sales alignment, fill rates and account-level business plans.
* Negotiate and execute promotional calendars, visibility investments and in-store activations.
* Identify growth opportunities across stores, categories, assortments and new product launches.

**2. Make Plum Win at the Shelf**

* Ensure strong on-shelf availability, impactful visibility and planogram compliance across priority stores.
* Identify store-level execution gaps and drive timely corrective actions.
* Work closely with retail partners and field teams to improve product discovery and consumer conversion.
* Ensure launches, promotions and visibility plans translate into stronger sell-out performance.

**3. Build a High-Performing Field Force**

* Lead and guide Key Account Executives, Supervisors, Merchandisers and Beauty Advisors across assigned accounts.
* Drive BA productivity through better deployment, training, coaching and performance reviews.
* Track key metrics such as sales per BA, store-level market share, target achievement and man-day productivity.
* Build accountability and execution discipline across field teams.
* Ensure incentive plans are implemented accurately and on time.

**4. Turn Data into Growth Decisions**

* Track account-wise and store-wise sales, stock availability, productivity and promotional performance.
* Identify what's working, what's not and where the next growth opportunity lies.
* Lead structured Monthly Business Reviews with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Use market intelligence and competitor insights to strengthen account strategies.
* Translate data into clear actions that improve revenue, visibility and productivity.

**5. Drive Commercial & Operational Excellence**

* Ensure timely closure of customer claims, reconciliations and No-Dues Certificates (NDCs).
* Partner with Finance and Channel teams to maintain strong financial and commercial discipline.
* Ensure adherence to agreed account terms, investments and promotional commitments.
* Work closely with Supply Chain and internal teams to resolve availability and operational issues.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in Modern Trade / Key Account Management, preferably within FMCG or consumer products.
* Strong understanding of the Tamil Nadu and Kerala Modern Trade landscape.
* Hands-on experience managing BA and Non-BA retail accounts.
* Experience working with regional or national retail chains and managing commercial relationships.
* Good understanding of sell-in, sell-out, inventory, visibility, promotions and retail productivity.
* Strong negotiation, analytical and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to independently drive account performance and manage field execution.
* High ownership, commercial orientation and willingness to spend time in the market.
* Exposure to Beauty & Personal Care would be an advantage.
* Must be based in Chennai.

If you believe great brands are built not just through marketing, but also by winning every day at the shelf, we'd love to hear from you.

Come help us make Plum a stronger consumer choice across Tamil Nadu & Kerala!
